title: Best Window Cleaning CRM (2026): Prices & Features
description: Window cleaning CRM compared: customer history, quote follow-ups, reminders and portals in Jobber, Housecall Pro and BookingKoala, prices checked Nov 2026.
h1: Best window cleaning CRM for customer history and follow-ups
body:
A window cleaning CRM is where your customer list lives: who you cleaned, what you charged, gate codes and access notes, which quotes are still open, and who is due for their next 8- or 12-week clean. This page compares the three tools we track on that customer-record angle: customer history, quote follow-ups, job notes, reminders and a customer portal. If you mainly want the general quoting-and-scheduling roundup, read our window cleaning business software guide; if you want customers to book on your website first, see window washing software for online booking. Every price and feature below comes from the vendor's own pages, re-checked 2026-11-08.

{{table:jobber,housecall-pro,bookingkoala}}

What a window cleaning CRM should track

  • Customer and property history: past cleans, prices, photos, and notes like pane count, stories, screens or access instructions.
  • Open quotes and follow-ups: a reminder (ideally automatic) when an estimate hasn't been approved.
  • Repeat-visit reminders: appointment reminders and a way to bring past customers back for the next clean.
  • A customer portal: so customers can approve quotes, see visits and pay without calling you.

1. Jobber: CRM, client hub and quoting on every plan

Jobber's window cleaning page says all plans include a CRM, an online customer portal, quoting, invoicing and payments. Its client manager keeps estimates, jobs, invoices and a full billing history per client, and job details can hold things like number of windows, roof pitch and photos. Client hub lets customers request work, approve quotes, pay a deposit, check upcoming visits and pay invoices. Lead tagging (with Mailchimp and QuickBooks Online sync) is listed on the pricing page.

Plan split for CRM work: Core is $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment, 1 user). Connect ($99/mo billed annually, $139/mo monthly) adds automated client reminders, automated quote and invoice follow-ups, automatic payments, checklists and QuickBooks Online sync. Grow ($149/mo billed annually, $199/mo monthly) adds two-way SMS, optional line items for upsells like gutters or pressure washing, and custom automations. Pipeline ($49/mo) and Marketing Suite ($99/mo) are add-ons below Plus ($399/mo billed annually, 5 users). Extra users are $29/mo each. Online cards are 2.9% + 30¢ and ACH is 1%. The trial is 14 days on Grow with no credit card. Full plan table: Jobber pricing.

2. Housecall Pro: markets itself as a window cleaning CRM

Housecall Pro's window cleaning page calls it "window cleaning CRM software" and lists customer and service history (contact details, property instructions, photos and past window washing jobs), property access notes and prior cleans saved with each customer, automatic follow-ups on open estimates, appointment reminders, "On My Way" texts, seasonal reminders to past customers, automatic review requests and a customer portal for appointments and invoices. Which plan tier includes estimate follow-ups and seasonal campaigns isn't stated on its pricing page (unknown).

Basic is $59/mo billed annually ($79/mo monthly) for 1 user and includes online booking, estimates, invoicing, a price book and review management. Essentials ($149/mo annually, $189/mo monthly) includes 5 users and adds checklists, photo reports, employee GPS and QuickBooks Online sync. MAX ($299/mo annually, $329/mo monthly) includes 8 users ($35/mo per extra user) and adds recurring service plans, route optimization and a sales proposal tool. Pipeline is listed as an add-on with no published price (unknown). Cards from 2.59%, bank payments 1%, no long-term contract, and a 14-day MAX trial with no credit card. More: Housecall Pro pricing.

3. BookingKoala: customer records built around online booking

BookingKoala lists window cleaning among its industries but is a booking platform first, not a quote-heavy field service CRM. On the CRM side, its pricing and features pages list a customer dashboard (customers view and manage their appointments, refer friends and buy gift cards), a job history tab, quotes you can send to potential customers, lead/contact forms, recurring appointments, email notifications (SMS from Growing), system logs and history, and a customer data import tool. Campaigns (email and text marketing, 5,000 contacts) is on Premium.

Starter starts at $27/mo (5 providers or 5 GB) with a website builder and booking forms. Growing starts at $57/mo (15 providers) and adds SMS notifications, referrals and ratings, gift cards and advanced reports. Premium starts at $197/mo (50 providers). No contracts or setup fee; 14-day free trial per the pricing FAQ. Card processing rates and QuickBooks support aren't published (unknown). Details: BookingKoala pricing and features. {{aff:bookingkoala|Try BookingKoala}}

Which window cleaning CRM fits you?

  • Solo, on a budget: Jobber Core ($29/mo billed annually) gives you the client manager, client hub and quoting. Move to Connect if you want quote follow-ups and reminders automated.
  • Crew that needs shared customer notes: Housecall Pro Essentials includes 5 users for $149/mo billed annually and its window cleaning page lists property access notes and service history for crews in the field. Compare seats with Jobber's 5-user tiers in Jobber vs Housecall Pro.
  • Mostly residential, customers book online: BookingKoala gives customers their own dashboard and books recurring cleans from your website, starting at $27/mo.
  • Want instant online quotes too: pair a CRM with a quoting tool like ResponsiBid, which connects to Jobber and Housecall Pro.

faq: What is the cheapest window cleaning CRM?

Of the tools we checked on 2026-11-08, BookingKoala Starter starts at $27/mo (booking-first, with a customer dashboard). The cheapest field service CRM is Jobber Core at $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment), which Jobber says includes a CRM, client hub, quoting, invoicing and payments.
Does Jobber automatically follow up on window cleaning quotes?
Yes, from the Connect plan ($99/mo billed annually, $139/mo monthly). Jobber's pricing page lists automated quote and invoice follow-ups and automated client reminders as Connect features.
Can Housecall Pro store property access notes for window cleaning jobs?

Yes. Housecall Pro's window cleaning page says it keeps property access notes and prior cleans with each customer, and crews can check addresses, job details, service history and access notes in the mobile app before each visit.

It's a booking platform with CRM features. Its pricing and features pages list a customer dashboard, job history, quotes, lead forms, recurring appointments, system logs and history, and Campaigns marketing on Premium. It doesn't publish QuickBooks support or card processing rates.
Do these window cleaning CRMs have free trials?
Jobber offers 14 days on Grow and Housecall Pro 14 days on MAX, both with no credit card. BookingKoala's pricing FAQ says you're charged only after a 14-day free trial.
